sisi.depan: A soft white floor recedes into an infinite white haze where a cluster of faint, pale grey rings drifts slowly in the far distance.
sisi.kanan: The uniform white floor blends into a hazy void, marked only by a single large, pale grey ring tilted on its axis far away.
sisi.belakang: Behind the viewpoint, the white floor fades into an endless haze containing the barely visible arc of a distant, fragmented grey ring.
sisi.kiri: To the left, the seamless white ground dissolves into mist, with several small, pale grey rings intersecting each other in the deep distance.

tengah: The space between the viewer and the distant haze is a completely empty and uninterrupted expanse of soft white floor.
atas: Above is a limitless white void that merges with the horizonless haze, with the faintest suggestions of pale grey rings at an extreme distance.
